# GxBake command line reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m gxbake.clidoc` from gxbake/cli.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command the `gxbake` executable (or `python -m gxbake`) accepts. Run with no
command, or with file paths, it opens the desktop app instead. For how the commands
fit together when porting a game, see [the porting workflow](workflow.md).

Sizes such as `448K`, `1.5M` or `6MiB` are accepted wherever an option takes a size.
Commands that check something exit with 1 when the check fails, so they can gate a
build or CI job.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`convert`](#gxbake-convert) | convert files or folders |
| [`formats`](#gxbake-formats) | list every image format GxBake reads and which optional packages are missing |
| [`decode`](#gxbake-decode) | decode images of any supported format to PNG (to check how they are read) |
| [`inspect`](#gxbake-inspect) | print what GxBake sees in a file or folder |
| [`rs`](#gxbake-rs) | list the NPCs and models in a RuneScape cache |
| [`ff7`](#gxbake-ff7) | look inside Final Fantasy VII field and battle models (.hrc, .p, .a, .tex, <base>aa) |
| [`ffxi`](#gxbake-ffxi) | look inside Final Fantasy XI DATs, sounds and file tables |
| [`validate`](#gxbake-validate) | check a staged gamedir like the disc builder does |
| [`budget`](#gxbake-budget) | per-map memory report against the GameCube port's windows |
| [`fit`](#gxbake-fit) | trim a .gct's top mips until it fits the world texture budget |
| [`sfx`](#gxbake-sfx) | shrink WAVs under the port's per-file sound cap (20 KiB gameplay, 48 KiB menu) |
| [`disc`](#gxbake-disc) | disc usage: sector cost, duplicate files and textures, files no map names |
| [`extract`](#gxbake-extract) | unpack a Quake/GoldSrc .pak, Source .vpk, .pk3 or Panda3D .mf archive |
| [`lumps`](#gxbake-lumps) | list, extract and sort the lumps of a map or of the port's baked map files (.gcd, _lf.gcd, .gcmeta) |
| [`slim`](#gxbake-slim) | show where a studio model's bytes go and thin its animation |
| [`lightmaps`](#gxbake-lightmaps) | pick each face's lightmap size by error and pack the atlas |
| [`squeeze`](#gxbake-squeeze) | measure smarter packing on a staged tree, and write what the port reads today |
| [`adpcm`](#gxbake-adpcm) | encode WAV or .gcpcm audio as GameCube DSP ADPCM (.dsp, one per channel) |
| [`yaz0`](#gxbake-yaz0) | Yaz0-compress files (Nintendo LZ), or decompress with -d |
| [`sky`](#gxbake-sky) | turn a panorama, cubemap cross/strip, photo or six faces into the port's sky sides |
| [`video`](#gxbake-video) | convert any video FFmpeg reads to a THP movie (the GameCube SDK's format: JPEG + DSP ADPCM) |
| [`pack`](#gxbake-pack) | list, extract, build and edit .gct texture packs |
| [`auto`](#gxbake-auto) | images to GX textures with the format and size picked automatically (TPL/BTI/GCT) |
| [`pbr`](#gxbake-pbr) | bake PBR material sets (albedo/normal/roughness/metal/AO/height/emissive, glTF) for TEV |
| [`hdr`](#gxbake-hdr) | EXR/HDR/PFM to tone-mapped textures, overbright lightmaps or GX sphere maps |
| [`build`](#gxbake-build) | run a gxbake.toml/.json manifest: batch conversions under budgets, incremental |
| [`tpl`](#gxbake-tpl) | list what is in .tpl, .bti and .gxm files (and decode them to PNG) |
| [`gui`](#gxbake-gui) | open the desktop app |

## `gxbake convert`

Convert files or folders.

```
gxbake convert paths [paths ...] --output OUTPUT [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--no-mipmaps] [--alpha
    {auto,on,off}] [--cmpr-refine] [--no-pack] [--pack-name PACK_NAME] [--raw-cmp] [--mdl-max-edge
    MDL_MAX_EDGE] [--mdl-anim-step MDL_ANIM_STEP] [--spr-scale SPR_SCALE] [--model-scale
    MODEL_SCALE] [--model-up {y,z}] [--model-skin-max-edge MODEL_SKIN_MAX_EDGE] [--no-model-full]
    [--model-static] [--model-fps MODEL_FPS] [--no-model-clips] [--no-blend-bones] [--rose-scale
    ROSE_SCALE] [--rose-yaw ROSE_YAW] [--rose-entry ROSE_ENTRY] [--panda-scale PANDA_SCALE]
    [--panda-yaw PANDA_YAW] [--rs-scale RS_SCALE] [--rs-yaw RS_YAW] [--rs-entry KIND:ID]
    [--ffxi-scale FFXI_SCALE] [--ffxi-yaw FFXI_YAW] [--ffxi-skeleton DAT] [--ffxi-music-wav]
    [--ff7-scale FF7_SCALE] [--ff7-yaw FF7_YAW] [--ff7-battle-scale FF7_BATTLE_SCALE] [--video-width
    VIDEO_WIDTH] [--video-height VIDEO_HEIGHT] [--video-fps VIDEO_FPS] [--video-format
    {gcvid,thp,both}] [--fit-world] [--wt-pool WT_POOL] [--wad-dir WAD_DIR] [--game-dir DIR_OR_VPK]
    [--map-texture-max MAP_TEXTURE_MAX] [--map-disp-power {0,1,2,3,4}] [--map-vis-merge LEAVES]
    [--no-map-hulls] [--no-map-shadows] [--no-map-props] [--cache CACHE] [--no-sky-detect]
    [--sky-yaw SKY_YAW] [--sky-fov SKY_FOV] [--sky-exposure SKY_EXPOSURE]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` … |  | files or folders (a gamedir, WADs, BSPs, models, images, audio, video) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** staged output folder |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` | `256` | largest texture side for loose images (power of two) |
| `--no-mipmaps` |  | write level 0 only |
| `--alpha {auto,on,off}` | `auto` | CMPR 1-bit alpha: auto uses it when the image has transparency |
| `--cmpr-refine` |  | least-squares CMPR endpoints for every texture: same size, closer colours, bytes differ from the disc builder |
| `--no-pack` |  | one .gct per loose image |
| `--pack-name PACK_NAME` | `textures` | loose images go to media/<name>.gct |
| `--raw-cmp` |  | also write media/<name>.cmp (level 0) per loose image |
| `--mdl-max-edge MDL_MAX_EDGE` | `64` | largest skin side in gc_studio/<name>t.mdl |
| `--mdl-anim-step MDL_ANIM_STEP` | `1` | keep every Nth animation frame in gc_studio/<name>.mdl (seqgroup 0 only) |
| `--spr-scale SPR_SCALE` | `2` | sprite downscale factor |
| `--model-scale MODEL_SCALE` | `1.0` | 3D model import: source units → GoldSrc units (USD: multiplies the stage's metersPerUnit scale) |
| `--model-up {y,z}` | `y` | 3D model import: source up axis (USD files use their own upAxis) |
| `--model-skin-max-edge MODEL_SKIN_MAX_EDGE` | `256` | 3D model import: largest skin side in models/<name>.mdl |
| `--no-model-full` |  | skip models/<name>.mdl for imported 3D models |
| `--model-static` |  | 3D model import: ignore skeletons and animations |
| `--model-fps MODEL_FPS` | `15` | 3D model import: animation sample rate |
| `--no-model-clips` |  | don't merge <name>@<clip>.<ext> animation files |
| `--no-blend-bones` |  | Source models: snap blended vertices to one bone instead of adding helper bones |
| `--rose-scale ROSE_SCALE` | `39.37` | ROSE Online models: GoldSrc units per metre |
| `--rose-yaw ROSE_YAW` | `90.0` | ROSE Online models: degrees to turn about Z (90 faces them +X) |
| `--rose-entry ROSE_ENTRY` |  | ROSE .zsc/.chr: convert only this object/character index (repeatable; default all) |
| `--panda-scale PANDA_SCALE` | `12.0` | Panda3D/Toontown models: GoldSrc units per Panda unit (12: a Toontown foot) |
| `--panda-yaw PANDA_YAW` | `-90.0` | Panda3D models: degrees to turn about Z (-90 turns Panda's +Y forward to GoldSrc's +X) |
| `--rs-scale RS_SCALE` | `0.35` | RuneScape caches: GoldSrc units per model unit (128 units = one tile) |
| `--rs-yaw RS_YAW` |  | RuneScape caches: extra degrees to turn about Z |
| `--rs-entry KIND:ID` |  | RuneScape caches: convert npc:<id> or model:<id> (repeatable; default every named NPC) |
| `--ffxi-scale FFXI_SCALE` | `39.37` | Final Fantasy XI models: GoldSrc units per FFXI unit |
| `--ffxi-yaw FFXI_YAW` |  | Final Fantasy XI models: extra degrees to turn about Z |
| `--ffxi-skeleton DAT` |  | Final Fantasy XI: race skeleton DAT for equipment and face DATs that have none of their own |
| `--ffxi-music-wav` |  | Final Fantasy XI: write .bgw music as WAVs under sound/ffxi/ instead of media/<name>.gcpcm |
| `--ff7-scale FF7_SCALE` | `2.5` | Final Fantasy VII field models: GoldSrc units per FF7 unit |
| `--ff7-yaw FF7_YAW` |  | Final Fantasy VII models: extra degrees to turn about Z |
| `--ff7-battle-scale FF7_BATTLE_SCALE` |  | Final Fantasy VII battle models: GoldSrc units per FF7 unit (0 = fit each model to 72 units tall) |
| `--video-width VIDEO_WIDTH` | `320` | GCVID frame width |
| `--video-height VIDEO_HEIGHT` | `240` | GCVID frame height |
| `--video-fps VIDEO_FPS` | `15` | GCVID frame rate |
| `--video-format {gcvid,thp,both}` | `gcvid` | videos become .gcvid + .gcpcm (the port's player today), .thp (the SDK movie format; see gxbake video), or both |
| `--fit-world` |  | trim world texture packs' top mips until they fit the engine's MEM1 pool |
| `--wt-pool WT_POOL` | `448K` | pool size for --fit-world |
| `--wad-dir WAD_DIR` |  | extra WAD search folder (repeatable) |
| `--game-dir DIR_OR_VPK` |  | Source maps: game folder or _dir.vpk to find materials in (repeatable; the map's own pakfile and the folder above maps/ are searched first) |
| `--map-texture-max MAP_TEXTURE_MAX` | `256` | Source maps: largest embedded texture side |
| `--map-disp-power {0,1,2,3,4}` | `2` | Source maps: displacement detail kept (2 = 5x5 vertices per displacement) |
| `--map-vis-merge LEAVES` | `8` | Source maps: PVS rows that differ by at most this many leaves are stored once as their union (only adds visible leaves; 0 keeps the exact PVS) |
| `--no-map-hulls` |  | Source maps: skip building collision hulls 1-3 (faster; players then only collide with hull 0) |
| `--no-map-shadows` |  | Source 2 maps: light without tracing shadows (faster) |
| `--no-map-props` |  | Source maps: don't turn prop_static into cycler_sprite entities |
| `--cache CACHE` |  | CMPR encode cache folder |
| `--no-sky-detect` |  | keep big 2:1 images, crosses, strips and .hdr files as textures instead of making skies of them |
| `--sky-yaw SKY_YAW` | `270.0` | panorama skies: engine yaw the image centre faces (0 rt, 90 bk, 180 lf, 270 ft) |
| `--sky-fov SKY_FOV` | `180.0` | flat photos as skies: horizontal degrees the photo covers |
| `--sky-exposure SKY_EXPOSURE` |  | .hdr panoramas: stops brighter (+) or darker (-) than auto |

## `gxbake formats`

List every image format GxBake reads and which optional packages are missing.

```
gxbake formats [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` |  | print the table as JSON |

## `gxbake decode`

Decode images of any supported format to PNG (to check how they are read).

```
gxbake decode images [images ...] [--output OUTPUT]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `images` … |  | image files or folders |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` | `.` | folder for the PNGs (default: here) |

## `gxbake inspect`

Print what GxBake sees in a file or folder.

```
gxbake inspect path
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | file or folder |

## `gxbake rs`

List the NPCs and models in a RuneScape cache.

```
gxbake rs path [--find FIND] [--all] [--limit LIMIT] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | main_file_cache.dat2 (JS5: OSRS / RS2) or main_file_cache.dat (2004-era), or its folder |
| `--find FIND` |  | only NPCs whose name contains this |
| `--all` |  | include NPCs named `null` (variants the client swaps in) |
| `--limit LIMIT` | `50` | NPCs to print (0 = all) |
| `--json` |  | print everything as JSON |

## `gxbake ff7`

Look inside Final Fantasy VII field and battle models (.hrc, .p, .a, .tex, <base>aa).

```
gxbake ff7 path [--anims] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | a skeleton (.hrc), polygon model (.p), animation (.a), texture (.tex) or battle skeleton (<base>aa) |
| `--anims` |  | for a .hrc: list the .a files beside it with the same bone count |
| `--json` |  | print as JSON |

## `gxbake ffxi`

Look inside Final Fantasy XI DATs, sounds and file tables.

```
gxbake ffxi path [--id ID] [--textures DIR] [--wav OUT] [--obj DIR] [--prefabs] [--scale SCALE]
    [--yaw YAW] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | a ROM DAT, a .spw/.bgw sound, or the FINAL FANTASY XI folder (with --id) |
| `--id ID` |  | resolve this file id through VTABLE/FTABLE and describe that DAT |
| `--textures DIR` |  | write the DAT's textures as PNGs here |
| `--wav OUT` |  | decode a .spw/.bgw to this WAV |
| `--obj DIR` |  | zone DATs: write the placed zone as OBJ + MTL + PNG textures here (GoldSrc axes and units) |
| `--prefabs` |  | with --obj: one OBJ per zone prefab instead of the placed zone |
| `--scale SCALE` | `39.37` | with --obj: GoldSrc units per FFXI unit |
| `--yaw YAW` |  | with --obj: extra degrees to turn about Z |
| `--json` |  | print as JSON |

## `gxbake validate`

Check a staged gamedir like the disc builder does.

```
gxbake validate path
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | staged gamedir |

## `gxbake budget`

Per-map memory report against the GameCube port's windows.

```
gxbake budget path [--map MAP] [--include GLOB] [--json] [--strict] [--verbose] [--pool POOL]
    [--split {64,32,16,8}] [--budget NAME=SIZE]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | staged gamedir (the output of convert) |
| `--map MAP` |  | only this map (repeatable) |
| `--include GLOB` |  | models every map loads, e.g. `models/v_*.mdl` (repeatable) |
| `--json` |  | print the report as JSON |
| `--strict` |  | exit 1 on warnings too |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | list the biggest items on every line |
| `--pool POOL` |  | world texture MEM1 pool (default 448K, GC_WT_POOL_BYTES) |
| `--split {64,32,16,8}` |  | split dimension the pool must manage (default 64; lower accepts softer textures) |
| `--budget NAME=SIZE` |  | override any budget, e.g. studio_arena=1.5M (repeatable) |

## `gxbake fit`

Trim a .gct's top mips until it fits the world texture budget.

```
gxbake fit path [--output OUTPUT] [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--pool POOL] [--split {64,32,16,8}]
    [--budget NAME=SIZE]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | world texture pack (.gct) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write the fitted pack here (otherwise a dry run) |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` |  | also cap every texture to this size first |
| `--pool POOL` |  | world texture MEM1 pool (default 448K, GC_WT_POOL_BYTES) |
| `--split {64,32,16,8}` |  | split dimension the pool must manage (default 64; lower accepts softer textures) |
| `--budget NAME=SIZE` |  | override any budget, e.g. studio_arena=1.5M (repeatable) |

## `gxbake sfx`

Shrink WAVs under the port's per-file sound cap (20 KiB gameplay, 48 KiB menu).

```
gxbake sfx paths [paths ...] [--output OUTPUT] [--in-place] [--menu] [--cap CAP] [--min-rate
    MIN_RATE] [--keep-stereo] [--no-8bit] [--truncate] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` … |  | .wav files or folders |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write fitted WAVs here, keeping relative paths |
| `--in-place` |  | overwrite the source files |
| `--menu` |  | use the 48 KiB menu-route cap |
| `--cap CAP` |  | explicit cap, e.g. 16K |
| `--min-rate MIN_RATE` | `11025` | lowest sample rate to fall back to |
| `--keep-stereo` |  | never fold stereo to mono |
| `--no-8bit` |  | never drop to 8-bit samples |
| `--truncate` |  | cut (with a 10 ms fade) what still does not fit |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | also list sounds that already fit |

## `gxbake disc`

Disc usage: sector cost, duplicate files and textures, files no map names.

```
gxbake disc path [--include GLOB] [--limit LIMIT] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | staged gamedir |
| `--include GLOB` |  | count these as referenced (repeatable) |
| `--limit LIMIT` | `15` | rows per section |
| `--json` |  | print the report as JSON |

## `gxbake extract`

Unpack a Quake/GoldSrc .pak, Source .vpk, .pk3 or Panda3D .mf archive.

```
gxbake extract archives [archives ...] --output OUTPUT [--match MATCH]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `archives` … |  | .pak, .vpk, .pk3 or .mf (e.g. Toontown's phase_3.mf) files |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** folder to extract into |
| `--match MATCH` |  | only members matching this glob, e.g. `models/*` (repeatable) |

## `gxbake lumps`

List, extract and sort the lumps of a map or of the port's baked map files (.gcd, _lf.gcd, .gcmeta).

```
gxbake lumps paths [paths ...] [--output OUTPUT] [--textures] [--names FILE] [--no-raw] [--limit
    LIMIT] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` … |  | GoldSrc/Quake/Source .bsp, media/wd_<map>.gcd world bakes, wd_<map>_lf.gcd light faces, <map>.gcmeta lump indexes, or folders holding them |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | extract into this folder (one subfolder per file): raw lumps, entities, sorted refs, textures, face batches and the port's .gcmeta; for .gcd the sections, materials, chunks and lightmap pages |
| `--textures` |  | with -o, also decode a BSP's embedded miptex to PNG |
| `--names FILE` |  | name a .gcd's materials from this BSP, WAD, .gct pack, texture-names.json or name list (default: media/wt_<map>.gct or maps/<map>.bsp next to it) |
| `--no-raw` |  | with -o, skip the raw lump and section .bin files |
| `--limit LIMIT` | `20` | rows per table in the report |
| `--json` |  | print the report as JSON |

## `gxbake slim`

Show where a studio model's bytes go and thin its animation.

```
gxbake slim path [--output OUTPUT] [--step STEP] [--stub PATTERN] [--keep PATTERN] [--anim-tol
    UNITS] [--fit-deg DEG] [--fit-units UNITS] [--max-step MAX_STEP]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | GoldSrc studio model (.mdl) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write the slimmed model here (otherwise a dry run) |
| `--step STEP` | `1` | keep every Nth animation frame (fps adjusted, same duration) |
| `--stub PATTERN` |  | reduce matching sequences to one frame (repeatable) |
| `--keep PATTERN` |  | never touch matching sequences (repeatable) |
| `--anim-tol UNITS` |  | hold animation values within ±UNITS so runs get longer (lossy, bounded; 0 = lossless re-encode only) |
| `--fit-deg DEG` |  | resample each sequence to the fewest evenly spaced keys that stay within DEG degrees of every bone |
| `--fit-units UNITS` |  | position tolerance for --fit-deg (default DEG / 10) |
| `--max-step MAX_STEP` | `8` | --fit-deg keeps keys at most this many frames apart |

## `gxbake lightmaps`

Pick each face's lightmap size by error and pack the atlas.

```
gxbake lightmaps path [--page PAGE] [--packer {quake,shelf,skyline}] [--pad PAD] [--min-db MIN_DB]
    [--flat-tol FLAT_TOL] [--no-resize] [--plan OUT.json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | GoldSrc BSP (v30) |
| `--page PAGE` | `128` | atlas page side in luxels |
| `--packer {quake,shelf,skyline}` | `skyline` | rectangle packer (quake = AllocBlock in map order) |
| `--pad PAD` | `1` | luxels of border right and below each face |
| `--min-db MIN_DB` | `40.0` | half resolution only when it stays within this PSNR |
| `--flat-tol FLAT_TOL` | `2` | a face within ±N of its mean becomes 1×1 |
| `--no-resize` |  | keep every face's size; only repack |
| `--plan OUT.json` |  | write per-face sizes and atlas positions for a world baker |

## `gxbake squeeze`

Measure smarter packing on a staged tree, and write what the port reads today.

```
gxbake squeeze path [--output OUTPUT] [--emit] [--preset {balanced,lossless,max}] [--min-db MIN_DB]
    [--anim-tol UNITS] [--anim-fit DEG] [--skin-db SKIN_DB] [--no-yaz0] [--only LIST] [--skip LIST]
    [--match GLOB] [--json] [--verbose]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `path` |  | staged gamedir (or one file) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write the results here, same relative paths (otherwise a report only) |
| `--emit` |  | with -o, also write the formats that need port support: .gsk skins, .dsp sound, .yaz0 |
| `--preset {balanced,lossless,max}` | `balanced` | starting quality: lossless (bit-exact only), balanced (default: ≥40 dB, ≤0.5° animation) or max (≥34 dB, ≤2°); the options below override it |
| `--min-db MIN_DB` |  | drop a world texture's top mip when the next level magnified is within this PSNR (balanced: 40) |
| `--anim-tol UNITS` |  | studio animation deadband (0 = lossless) |
| `--anim-fit DEG` |  | resample studio animation to the fewest keys within DEG degrees (0 = off; balanced: 0.5) |
| `--skin-db SKIN_DB` |  | lossy skin formats must stay within this PSNR of RGB565 (balanced: 40) |
| `--no-yaz0` |  | skip the (slow) Yaz0 estimate (same as --skip yaz0) |
| `--only LIST` |  | only these techniques, comma-separated: trim, anim, skins, adpcm, verts, lightmaps, yaz0, dedup (repeatable) |
| `--skip LIST` |  | leave these techniques out (same names as --only) (repeatable) |
| `--match GLOB` |  | only these relative paths (repeatable) |
| `--json` |  | print every row as JSON |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | list every file |

## `gxbake adpcm`

Encode WAV or .gcpcm audio as GameCube DSP ADPCM (.dsp, one per channel).

```
gxbake adpcm paths [paths ...] --output OUTPUT
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` … |  | .wav or .gcpcm files |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** folder for the .dsp files |

## `gxbake yaz0`

Yaz0-compress files (Nintendo LZ), or decompress with -d.

```
gxbake yaz0 paths [paths ...] [--decompress] [--output OUTPUT]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` … |  | files |
| `-d`, `--decompress` |  | decompress .yaz0 files |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | folder to write into (default: next to the input) |

## `gxbake sky`

Turn a panorama, cubemap cross/strip, photo or six faces into the port's sky sides.

```
gxbake sky inputs [inputs ...] --output OUTPUT [--name NAME] [--layout
    {auto,equirect,cross,strip,faces,photo}] [--yaw YAW] [--fov FOV] [--exposure EXPOSURE]
    [--tonemap {aces,reinhard,hable,agx,clip}] [--size SIZE] [--env SIZE] [--preview PNG]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputs` … |  | one image (equirectangular panorama, .hdr, 4:3/3:4 cross, 6:1 strip or a photo), six face images, or a folder holding them |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** staged gamedir; sides go to media/sky_<name><side>.cmp |
| `--name NAME` |  | sky name (worldspawn "skyname"); default from the file name |
| `--layout {auto,equirect,cross,strip,faces,photo}` | `auto` | how to read the input; auto guesses from its shape |
| `--yaw YAW` | `270.0` | engine yaw the image centre (or the cross's front) faces: 0 rt, 90 bk, 180 lf, 270 ft |
| `--fov FOV` | `180.0` | photo layout: horizontal degrees the photo covers; mirrored copies fill the rest |
| `--exposure EXPOSURE` |  | .hdr input: stops brighter (+) or darker (-) than auto |
| `--tonemap {aces,reinhard,hable,agx,clip}` | `aces` | HDR input (.hdr/.exr/.pfm): tone-mapping curve |
| `--size SIZE` | `128` | side size; the port loads only 128 |
| `--env SIZE` |  | also write gfx/env/<name><side>.tga at SIZE (PC builds, the disc builder) |
| `--preview PNG` |  | write the decoded sides as a cross to check seams and orientation |

## `gxbake video`

Convert any video FFmpeg reads to a THP movie (the GameCube SDK's format: JPEG + DSP ADPCM).

```
gxbake video inputs [inputs ...] --output OUTPUT [--max WxH] [--size WxH] [--stretch] [--fps FPS]
    [--max-fps MAX_FPS] [--quality QUALITY] [--max-kbps MAX_KBPS] [--max-size SIZE] [--min-quality
    MIN_QUALITY] [--audio-rate {32000,48000}] [--audio-track AUDIO_TRACK] [--no-audio] [--start
    START] [--duration DURATION] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputs` … |  | video files (any codec and container FFmpeg reads) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** NAME.thp for one input, otherwise a folder (one <stem>.thp each) |
| `--max WxH` | `512x448` | fit the picture inside this box, keeping the aspect; sides round down to multiples of 16, at most 640x480 |
| `--size WxH` |  | exact size instead (multiples of 16); letterboxed unless --stretch |
| `--stretch` |  | with --size, stretch to fill instead of letterboxing |
| `--fps FPS` |  | frame rate (default: the source's, halved or thirded to --max-fps) |
| `--max-fps MAX_FPS` | `30.0` | highest frame rate kept from the source |
| `--quality QUALITY` | `80` | JPEG quality 1-100 |
| `--max-kbps MAX_KBPS` |  | cap the video at this many kbit/s: frames over it drop quality, down to --min-quality |
| `--max-size SIZE` |  | cap the whole file (e.g. 20M); sets the per-frame cap from the length |
| `--min-quality MIN_QUALITY` | `10` | lowest JPEG quality a capped frame may drop to |
| `--audio-rate {32000,48000}` | `32000` | audio sample rate (stereo DSP ADPCM) |
| `--audio-track AUDIO_TRACK` |  | which audio stream of the source |
| `--no-audio` |  | video only |
| `--start START` |  | start this many seconds in |
| `--duration DURATION` |  | convert this many seconds (0: to the end) |
| `--json` |  | print the results as JSON |

## `gxbake pack`

Manage GCWT texture packs (.gct) directly. Entry names are the image file names, lowercased and cut to 15 characters; the engine reads at most 512 entries per pack.

```
gxbake pack action ...
```

### `gxbake pack list`

The textures in a pack with their sizes.

```
gxbake pack list pack [--name GLOB] [--sort {pack,size}] [--json]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pack` |  | .gct file |
| `--name GLOB` |  | only matching names (repeatable) |
| `--sort {pack,size}` | `pack` | pack order or largest first |
| `--json` |  | print the list as JSON |

### `gxbake pack extract`

Decode textures to PNG, as the GameCube samples them.

```
gxbake pack extract pack --output OUTPUT [--name GLOB] [--all-levels]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pack` |  | .gct file |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** folder for the PNGs |
| `--name GLOB` |  | only matching names (repeatable) |
| `--all-levels` |  | also write every mip level as <name>_mip<N>.png |

### `gxbake pack build`

Encode images into a new pack.

```
gxbake pack build images [images ...] --output OUTPUT [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--no-mipmaps] [--alpha
    {auto,on,off}] [--cmpr-refine]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `images` … |  | image files or folders |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** .gct to write |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` | `256` | largest texture side (power of two) |
| `--no-mipmaps` |  | write level 0 only |
| `--alpha {auto,on,off}` | `auto` | CMPR 1-bit alpha: auto uses it when the image has transparency |
| `--cmpr-refine` |  | least-squares CMPR endpoints: same size, closer colours (+0.3 dB median, up to +2.4 dB) |

### `gxbake pack add`

Add images to a pack, replacing entries with the same name.

```
gxbake pack add pack images [images ...] [--output OUTPUT] [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--no-mipmaps]
    [--alpha {auto,on,off}] [--cmpr-refine]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pack` |  | .gct file |
| `images` … |  | image files or folders |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write here instead of updating the pack in place |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` | `256` | largest texture side (power of two) |
| `--no-mipmaps` |  | write level 0 only |
| `--alpha {auto,on,off}` | `auto` | CMPR 1-bit alpha: auto uses it when the image has transparency |
| `--cmpr-refine` |  | least-squares CMPR endpoints: same size, closer colours (+0.3 dB median, up to +2.4 dB) |

### `gxbake pack remove`

Drop entries by name.

```
gxbake pack remove pack GLOB [GLOB ...] [--output OUTPUT]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pack` |  | .gct file |
| `GLOB` … |  | names or globs to remove |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | write here instead of updating the pack in place |

### `gxbake pack merge`

Combine packs; a later pack wins on a name clash.

```
gxbake pack merge packs [packs ...] --output OUTPUT
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `packs` … |  | .gct files, in priority order (last wins) |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** .gct to write |

## `gxbake auto`

Images to GX textures with the format and size picked automatically (TPL/BTI/GCT).

```
gxbake auto inputs [inputs ...] --output OUTPUT [--min-db MIN_DB] [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--formats
    FORMATS] [--no-mipmaps] [--budget SIZE] [--container {tpl,bti,gct}] [--preview DIR] [--jobs
    JOBS] [--json] [--role {auto,color,world,ui,mask,normal,lightmap}] [--combine NAME.tpl]
    [--no-recursive] [--npot] [--wrap {repeat,clamp}]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputs` … |  | images, folders (recursive) or globs |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** folder to write into |
| `--min-db MIN_DB` | `38.0` | quality floor: the smallest format whose PSNR against the source stays above this wins |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` | `256` | largest texture side |
| `--formats FORMATS` |  | comma list of GX formats to allow (I4, I8, IA4, IA8, CI4, CI8, CMPR, RGB565, RGB5A3, RGBA8) |
| `--no-mipmaps` |  | level 0 only |
| `--budget SIZE` |  | total bytes for every texture written (e.g. 448K): formats and sizes step down where it costs least |
| `--container {tpl,bti,gct}` |  | file format (default tpl) |
| `--preview DIR` |  | also write each texture decoded as the GameCube samples it |
| `-j JOBS`, `--jobs JOBS` | `1` | encode in this many processes |
| `--json` |  | print the results as JSON |
| `--role {auto,color,world,ui,mask,normal,lightmap}` | `auto` | which formats suit the content: ui keeps edges crisp (no CMPR), world is CMPR only, mask is I4/I8 |
| `--combine NAME.tpl` |  | every image in one TPL, plus NAME.h with an index per image |
| `--no-recursive` |  | do not descend into sub-folders |
| `--npot` |  | keep non-power-of-two sizes (forces clamp; mips need powers of two) |
| `--wrap {repeat,clamp}` | `repeat` | TPL wrap mode |

## `gxbake pbr`

Bake PBR material sets (albedo/normal/roughness/metal/AO/height/emissive, glTF) for TEV.

```
gxbake pbr inputs [inputs ...] --output OUTPUT [--min-db MIN_DB] [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--formats
    FORMATS] [--no-mipmaps] [--budget SIZE] [--container {tpl,bti,gct}] [--preview DIR] [--jobs
    JOBS] [--json] [--preset {prelit,lit,emboss,indirect}] [--env ENV] [--env-size ENV_SIZE]
    [--env-roughness ENV_ROUGHNESS] [--tonemap {aces,reinhard,hable,agx,clip}] [--light LIGHT]
    [--detail DETAIL] [--ao-strength AO_STRENGTH] [--spec-strength SPEC_STRENGTH] [--gct-base
    NAME.gct] [--list]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputs` … |  | folders or files of material maps, or .gltf/.glb files |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** folder to write into |
| `--min-db MIN_DB` | `36.0` | quality floor: the smallest format whose PSNR against the source stays above this wins |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` | `256` | largest texture side |
| `--formats FORMATS` |  | comma list of GX formats to allow (I4, I8, IA4, IA8, CI4, CI8, CMPR, RGB565, RGB5A3, RGBA8) |
| `--no-mipmaps` |  | level 0 only |
| `--budget SIZE` |  | total bytes for every texture written (e.g. 448K): formats and sizes step down where it costs least |
| `--container {tpl,bti,gct}` |  | file format (default tpl) |
| `--preview DIR` |  | also write each texture decoded as the GameCube samples it |
| `-j JOBS`, `--jobs JOBS` | `1` | encode in this many processes |
| `--json` |  | print the results as JSON |
| `--preset {prelit,lit,emboss,indirect}` | `lit` | prelit: one baked texture; lit: base (+spec, +glow) for engine lighting; emboss: + height for GX emboss bump; indirect: + IA8 normal and a sphere map for reflections |
| `--env ENV` |  | indirect preset: panorama, cubemap or HDR to render the reflection sphere map from |
| `--env-size ENV_SIZE` | `128` | sphere map size |
| `--env-roughness ENV_ROUGHNESS` | `auto` | blur of the sphere map: 0-1, or auto (the material's median) |
| `--tonemap {aces,reinhard,hable,agx,clip}` | `aces` | for an HDR --env |
| `--light LIGHT` |  | tangent-space key light x,y,z for prelit (default upper left: -0.45,0.55,0.7) |
| `--detail DETAIL` |  | how strongly normal-map detail is painted into the base (default 1) |
| `--ao-strength AO_STRENGTH` |  | AO multiplier (default 1) |
| `--spec-strength SPEC_STRENGTH` |  | prelit highlight strength (default 0.6) |
| `--gct-base NAME.gct` |  | also pack every base map as CMPR in one .gct for the port |
| `--list` |  | only show the material sets found and which file feeds each map |

## `gxbake hdr`

EXR/HDR/PFM to tone-mapped textures, overbright lightmaps or GX sphere maps.

```
gxbake hdr inputs [inputs ...] --output OUTPUT [--min-db MIN_DB] [--max-edge MAX_EDGE] [--formats
    FORMATS] [--no-mipmaps] [--budget SIZE] [--container {tpl,bti,gct}] [--preview DIR] [--jobs
    JOBS] [--json] [--mode {texture,lightmap,sphere}] [--tonemap {aces,reinhard,hable,agx,clip}]
    [--exposure EXPOSURE] [--no-auto-exposure] [--white WHITE] [--overbright {auto,1,2,4}] [--gamma
    GAMMA] [--role {auto,color,world,ui,mask,normal,lightmap}] [--size SIZE] [--yaw YAW] [--pitch
    PITCH] [--roughness ROUGHNESS] [--layout {auto,equirect,cross,strip,faces,photo}]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `inputs` … |  | HDR images (also any 8-bit image), folders or globs |
| `-o OUTPUT`, `--output OUTPUT` |  | **Required.** folder to write into |
| `--min-db MIN_DB` | `38.0` | quality floor: the smallest format whose PSNR against the source stays above this wins |
| `--max-edge MAX_EDGE` | `256` | largest texture side |
| `--formats FORMATS` |  | comma list of GX formats to allow (I4, I8, IA4, IA8, CI4, CI8, CMPR, RGB565, RGB5A3, RGBA8) |
| `--no-mipmaps` |  | level 0 only |
| `--budget SIZE` |  | total bytes for every texture written (e.g. 448K): formats and sizes step down where it costs least |
| `--container {tpl,bti,gct}` |  | file format (default tpl) |
| `--preview DIR` |  | also write each texture decoded as the GameCube samples it |
| `-j JOBS`, `--jobs JOBS` | `1` | encode in this many processes |
| `--json` |  | print the results as JSON |
| `--mode {texture,lightmap,sphere}` | `texture` | texture: tone-map; lightmap: store light/scale for a TEV stage scaled ×2/×4; sphere: render a sphere map for GX_TG_NRM reflections |
| `--tonemap {aces,reinhard,hable,agx,clip}` | `aces` | texture and sphere modes: curve |
| `--exposure EXPOSURE` |  | stops over the automatic exposure (lightmap: over 1.0) |
| `--no-auto-exposure` |  | texture mode: use the values as they are, scaled only by --exposure |
| `--white WHITE` | `4.0` | reinhard/hable: the input level that maps to white |
| `--overbright {auto,1,2,4}` | `auto` | lightmap TEV scale; auto takes the smallest that clips at most 0.1%% of texels |
| `--gamma GAMMA` | `1.0` | lightmap: store light^(1/gamma) (1 = linear, what TEV multiplies) |
| `--role {auto,color,world,ui,mask,normal,lightmap}` |  | format set (default lightmap for lightmaps, else auto) |
| `--size SIZE` | `128` | sphere mode: map size |
| `--yaw YAW` | `270.0` | sphere mode: engine yaw the camera faces (270 = -Y, the sky's ft) |
| `--pitch PITCH` |  | sphere mode: camera pitch in degrees |
| `--roughness ROUGHNESS` |  | sphere mode: blur, 0 (mirror) to 1 (very rough) |
| `--layout {auto,equirect,cross,strip,faces,photo}` | `auto` | sphere mode: how to read the source |

## `gxbake build`

Run a gxbake.toml/.json manifest: batch conversions under budgets, incremental.

```
gxbake build [manifest] [--init] [--force] [--dry-run] [--jobs JOBS] [--json] [--watch] [--interval
    INTERVAL]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest` |  | manifest file or folder holding gxbake.toml (default: here) |
| `--init` |  | write a commented example gxbake.toml |
| `--force` |  | rebuild everything (and let --init overwrite) |
| `--dry-run` |  | show what would be built |
| `-j JOBS`, `--jobs JOBS` |  | worker processes (default: [build] jobs, or 1) |
| `--json` |  | print the build report as JSON |
| `--watch` |  | keep running: rebuild what changed whenever an input or the manifest changes |
| `--interval INTERVAL` | `1.0` | --watch: seconds between checks |

## `gxbake tpl`

List what is in .tpl, .bti and .gxm files (and decode them to PNG).

```
gxbake tpl files [files ...] [--extract DIR]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `files` … |  | .tpl, .bti or .gxm files |
| `--extract DIR` |  | write every image's top level as PNG, as the GameCube samples it |

## `gxbake gui`

Open the desktop app.

```
gxbake gui [paths ...]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `paths` … |  | files or folders to open |

## Budget names

The limits `budget` and `fit` check, taken from the Xash3D GameCube port. Change any of them with `--budget NAME=SIZE` (repeatable), e.g. `--budget studio_arena=1.5M`.

| Name | Default | What it limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `main_ram` | 24.0 MiB (25,165,824 bytes) | GameCube main RAM (MEM1) |
| `aram` | 16.0 MiB (16,777,216 bytes) | auxiliary RAM (ARAM) |
| `disc` | 1.4 GiB (1,459,978,240 bytes) | usable bytes on a GameCube disc |
| `wt_pool` | 448.0 KiB (458,752 bytes) | world texture MEM1 pool: table, resident low mips and hot ring (GC_WT_POOL_BYTES) |
| `wt_min_hot` | 32.0 KiB (32,768 bytes) | smallest hot ring the split rule accepts (GC_WT_MIN_HOT_BYTES) |
| `wt_split` | 64 | split dimension a pack must fit at to count as ok (a number, not a size) |
| `wt_aram` | 6.0 MiB (6,291,456 bytes) | world texture ARAM store (GC_WT_ARAM_BYTES) |
| `wt_max_textures` | 512 | entries per world pack the engine reads (a count) |
| `studio_arena` | 1.0 MiB (1,048,576 bytes) | studio model MEM1 arena per map |
| `sfx_cache` | 128.0 KiB (131,072 bytes) | MEM1 sound cache (GC_SFX_BUDGET_BYTES; 320K on the menu route) |
| `sfx_max_file` | 20.0 KiB (20,480 bytes) | largest WAV PCM the loader accepts (GC_SFX_MAX_FILE_BYTES; 48K on the menu route) |
| `sfx_aram` | 2.0 MiB (2,097,152 bytes) | ARAM sound store |
| `lightmap_atlas` | 800.0 KiB (819,200 bytes) | lightmap atlas |
